title: Pipe Maze
description: Find the farthest point in a pipe loop and count enclosed tiles.
writeup:
## Approach

Parse the grid and find the `S` starting position. Determine which pipe segments connect to neighbors by checking that both endpoints agree on the connection.

## Part 1

BFS from `S` along connected pipe segments. The farthest point is simply the maximum BFS distance, since the loop has two paths of equal length meeting at the farthest tile.

## Part 2

Count tiles enclosed by the loop using ray casting. Scan each row left to right, tracking whether we're inside or outside the loop. A `|` crossing toggles the state. Corner pairs matter: `L...7` and `F...J` are true crossings (toggle), while `L...J` and `F...7` are U-turns (no toggle). First replace `S` with its actual pipe character so ray casting handles it correctly.
